video_title: Postgame Media Availability vs. Golden State Warriors (10/05/26) | LA Clippers

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on Kobe Brown's unwavering confidence and aggressive play
quotes.excerpt: his confidence doesn't waver. Same facial expressions, playing through the game.
quotes.quote: Like we talked about before, his confidence doesn't waver. Same facial expressions, playing through the game. Down the stretch made a big shot to put us up. But he took some great shots, shots that we want him taking, being aggressive, and so we're very confident he can make those shots.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue is impressed with Kobe Brown's poise and aggression on the floor. Lue says Brown's confidence does not waver and he is taking the shots the team wants him to take.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue praises Kobe Brown's offensive versatility and scoring impact
quotes.excerpt: He did a great job. I talked to him two days ago and asked him could he average 18 points.
quotes.quote: He did a great job. I talked to him two days ago and asked him could he average 18 points a game, and he said, 'I had 18 in the first half, coach.' But just being able to move him around, coming off screens, posting him, you can do some different things with him, so I'm excited about that, and we're going to need his scoring.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue is looking for more scoring from Kobe Brown this season. Lue revealed he challenged Brown to average 18 points a game and plans to use him in various roles including coming off screens and posting up.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue addresses Max Christie's early game injury
quotes.excerpt: I just saw him come off by itself and he kind of hobbled off and went off.
quotes.quote: I just saw him come off by itself and he kind of hobbled off and went off, so that's never good to see when it's a non-contact play. We'll get back, get the testing done, and see what's going on.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue says Max Christie will undergo testing after leaving the game with a non-contact injury. Lue noted it is never good to see a player hobble off like that.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on team's offensive struggles and defensive pressure
quotes.excerpt: I think that pressure kind of sped us up and took us out of the offense.
quotes.quote: We didn't do the things we worked on, but I think that pressure kind of sped us up and took us out of the offense that we wanted to run. And so, that's to be expected in game one. The run and jump hurt us a little bit because we haven't prepared for that yet, because we still got three weeks to put everything in.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue says the Clippers were sped up by defensive pressure in their preseason opener. He noted the team has not yet prepared for the run and jump defense they faced.

quotes.speaker: Kobe Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Kobe Brown on maintaining confidence despite early shooting struggles
quotes.excerpt: my teammates were saying to me, 'Keep shooting it, no matter if it makes or misses.'
quotes.quote: My teammates were saying to me, 'Keep shooting it, no matter if it makes or misses.' This is preseason, this is the time to get better, and the only way to get better is to shoot shots. So, I just went out there and tried to play free, play confident. Shots didn't really fall tonight, but I stayed confident the whole game.
quotes.social_post: Kobe Brown says his teammates are encouraging him to keep shooting despite early preseason struggles. Brown says he is focused on playing free and staying confident.

quotes.speaker: Kobe Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Kobe Brown on the team's supportive culture and collective success
quotes.excerpt: they want to see other people succeed and that's what it's been throughout the whole summer.
quotes.quote: They're great, they're all great teammates, great people, and they want to see other people succeed and that's what it's been throughout the whole summer being around them is that they want to make each other better, and as you can see like they're so happy for each other's success and it's not like we're not a selfish team, so it's fun to be around those guys.
quotes.social_post: Kobe Brown praises the unselfish culture of the Clippers. Brown says the team is focused on making each other better and celebrating collective success.

quotes.speaker: Amir Coffey
quotes.summary_phrase: Amir Coffey on adjusting to a new system and team environment
quotes.excerpt: this is a new system for me, a new team, a lot of new faces.
quotes.quote: This is a new system for me, a new team, a lot of new faces, coaches, and coaching staff. I've been communicating, it's been great. It's our first game, we got the dub, it was a pretty good game, but overall I think we did what we wanted to do.
quotes.social_post: Amir Coffey says he is adjusting well to the new system and coaching staff in his first game with the Clippers. Coffey says the team accomplished what they wanted to do in the opener.

quotes.speaker: Amir Coffey
quotes.summary_phrase: Amir Coffey on his role and coaching staff's expectations for aggression
quotes.excerpt: they've been communicating, I've been communicating with them, how much they want me to be aggressive.
quotes.quote: With the new team and Tyronn Lue, the coaching stuff, they've been communicating, I've been communicating with them, how much they want me to be aggressive, especially on the offense side. We talk about what's the plays and stuff, the things that I like, the things that I don't like, and they've been good with that. They're making the right plays, like calls, that's why I got easy shots.
quotes.social_post: Amir Coffey says Tyronn Lue and the coaching staff are pushing him to be more aggressive on the offensive end. Coffey says the coaching staff is actively seeking his input on plays he likes.

quotes.speaker: Amir Coffey
quotes.summary_phrase: Amir Coffey on utilizing his veteran experience with the Clippers
quotes.excerpt: this is my eighth year, I've been in the playoffs many times.
quotes.quote: This is my eighth year, I've been in the playoffs many times and there's this experience. Tyronn Lue, especially, he's been in a lot of big games, playoffs, and the championships, so he understands and I understand him. He's what he wants to do and just being communicating, I've been communicating with him a lot, especially this whole camp.
quotes.social_post: Amir Coffey says his eight years of experience helps him connect with Tyronn Lue. Coffey noted that he and Lue have been communicating throughout training camp to align on expectations.

quotes.speaker: Amir Coffey
quotes.summary_phrase: Amir Coffey on the team's fast-paced offensive system
quotes.excerpt: I like the how we both move the ball, you know, quick.
quotes.quote: I like the how we both move the ball, you know, quick. Especially we are younger too, so we can run the core, full core. He like when we get the rebound, he wants us to push, you know, push the ball. I get the rebound and I can push the ball, you know, easy. And then yeah, it's more so like playing for each other, you know, that's that's going to help us.
quotes.social_post: Amir Coffey says the Clippers are emphasizing a fast-paced offense this season. Coffey noted that Tyronn Lue wants the team to push the ball in transition whenever they grab a rebound.
